Correct integrations of each curve — B1, B1; subtraction not required for these marks, allow unsimplified: $18x-\frac3{28}x^{7/2}$ and $\frac34x^3-6x^2+18x$, or combined equivalent; condone sign errors due only to missing brackets.
Clear substitution of 4 into at least one integrated expression defined by at least one correct power — M1.
$240/7$ or $34.3$ AWRT — A1. SC: if all marks except final M1 awarded, SCB1 for correct final answer.
Total: 5

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$dy/dx=-\frac{5\times3}{2\times8}x^{3/2}=-\frac{15}{16}x^{3/2}$ — B1; allow unsimplified.
$dy/dt=(dy/dx)(dx/dt)=-\frac{15}{16}\times8\times2$ — M1; substitute $x=4$ into their derivative and multiply by 2.
$-15$ — A1; accept decreasing at/by 15. If incorrect curve used, not a misread and only M1 is available; expect $(\frac92(4)-12)\times2=12$.
Total: 3
